Regular Data Releases

Monthly Housing Starts and Other Construction Data

Monthly release of statistics on housing starts in Canada, issued on the 11th working day of the month.

2026 release dates:

  • Friday, Jan. 16
  • Monday, Feb. 16
  • Monday, March 16
  • Friday, April 17
  • Friday, May 15
  • Monday, June 15
  • Thursday, July 16
  • Tuesday, Aug. 18
  • Wednesday, Sept. 16
  • Friday, Oct. 16
  • Tuesday, Nov. 17
  • Tuesday, Dec. 15

Housing Information Monthly

Monthly release of more than 90 easy-to-read, data-rich statistical tables on starts, completions, absorptions and prices for provincial and local markets.

Housing Market Information Portal

Free, easy-to-use access anytime to the latest housing market data for Canada.
